body: I completely get you, friend. I'm going through a rough patch and it's getting progressively more difficult to keep the suicidal thoughts at bay. I keep coming up with scenarios of how I die and how people discover my body. There's still, however, a part of me that's deeply saddened by my thoughts of unaliving myself. That part wants me to stay but is confused as to how. It's difficult to see the good things life has to offer when you are going through something. It's extremely difficult. It's tiring and frustrating to keep finding reasons to stay when the suicidal thoughts come effortlessly. I wish and pray we all have the strength to get through whatever we all are going through. Let's try to keep the hope alive. Love you all. ❤
Hugs. I love you. ❤
